title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
☀️ Good morning, Matthew! It's Monday, November 2, 2026.

🌤️ Weather
About 50°F this morning, rising to a high near 65°F. Low tonight is around 50°F. Expect a mix of sun and clouds and only a small chance of rain. It should stay dry today, with rain likely back late in the week.
What to wear: a light jacket or layers. You can skip the umbrella today.

🗞️ Headlines
• Midterms are TOMORROW (Nov 3). Trump spent the final weekend rallying in Iowa and Kansas, and several Senate and House races are still close.
• A Learjet crashed in Palm Beach County, FL, a few miles from Mar-a-Lago, killing all 9 people on board. The FAA is investigating.
• A federal judge rejected the Justice Department's bid that could have blocked certification of Alaska's Senate election.
• Russia & Ukraine: Russian strikes cut power to thousands of Ukrainians as the Kherson ceasefire ends, and air-raid alert apps in both countries were hit by cyberattacks.
• NYC: The death toll from a lithium-ion battery fire in the Bronx has risen to four. At yesterday's NYC Marathon, Almgren won the men's race in his marathon debut and Chepkirui won the women's race.

🚇 Getting around
• J train: on weekdays from 10am to 3pm (through Nov 20), it runs on the local track between Marcy Av and Myrtle Av–Broadway, so midday trips will be slower.
• No other major planned changes found for today. Check the MTA app before you leave in case of delays.

🎉 NYC today
• It's Election Eve. Tomorrow New Yorkers vote for governor, attorney general and state legislature seats, and polls are open 6am–9pm.
• Broadway: Billy Crystal is returning to Broadway in "860," and "In the Heights" is playing at City Center. The holiday season is starting up too, and the NY Comedy Festival begins Friday (Nov 6–15).

💡 Nugget
Clocks fell back yesterday, so it gets dark around 4:50pm now. Plan any outdoor time or daylight errands for earlier in the day, and look up your poll site tonight at findmypollsite.vote.nyc so tomorrow is quick.
